content:
acme-platform: Hey @jess — our app started getting 403s on text generation right after we rotated keys. Embeddings calls still succeed. No stack traces in our side. Can you help?

jess: Sorry you're blocked. Can you share the exact curl you're using and the response body? Also which endpoint (chat/generate/embeddings) and timestamp of rotation?

acme-platform: Using /v1/generate. Rotation event from our SSO at 2026-02-12T14:03Z. Example curl (key redacted):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v1","input":"hi"}'
```

Response:

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": {
    "message": "insufficient_entitlement: missing generation permission",
    "code": 403
  }
}
```

acme-platform: Note: embedding call to /v1/embeddings with same key returns 200 and vectors.

jess: Thanks. That error suggests the token's claims are missing the generation entitlement. I'm going to pull the token claim dump from our admin logs — @mira can you check the claim set for that token id (starts with svc_1a2b)?

deploy-bot: rotation-event svc_1a2b created by sso-sync (user: alice@acme.com) at 2026-02-12T14:03Z

mira: I fetched the claim set for svc_1a2b. Snippet (sensitive fields masked):

```
iss: redwood
sub: svc_1a2b
scopes: ["embeddings","rerank"]
roles: ["service"]
```

mira: generation is indeed missing. It looks like the provisioner dropped the "generate" scope during SSO CSV -> claims translation. I'm seeing the same pattern as a delimiter-parsing bug (trailing space after comma) in the rotation payload.

jess: That would explain embeddings working and generation failing silently with 403. Two mitigation paths:
1) Quick fix: create a new API key from the Console for this service account and ensure the "Text generation" toggle is ON. This bypasses the SSO provisioning path.
2) Root fix: re-run the SSO provisioning job after we patch the CSV parser. @sam take this for security review and patch schedule.

sam: Acknowledged. I can reproduce locally: provisioner treats "embeddings, generate" with a trailing space as two scopes ["embeddings","generate"]? Actually our parser trims but the bug is when the scope name equals "generation" vs "generate" — mismatch in naming conventions. We'll standardize accepted aliases and add unit tests. Target ETA for patch: 2026-02-16.

acme-platform: For now we'll create a new console key. Any risk to rotating again? We use automated rotation nightly.

jess: If your rotation continues to use the SSO pipeline, new keys will inherit the same mis-translation. Workaround: set rotation to use Console-created keys until we deploy the provisioner fix. Also you can add a follow-up Slack hook to alert if generation scope missing — we can enable a quick monitor.

mira: Created internal ticket INFRA-1429 with repro steps and sample CSV. Adding a temporary server-side check that rejects rotated keys missing generation for orgs that have generation enabled.

acme-platform: Thanks — created new console key and verified /v1/generate returns 200 now. You can close on our side once the patch lands.

jess: Great. I'll keep INFRA-1429 linked to this thread and follow up when the fix is deployed. If you want I can subscribe you to the release note.

acme-platform: Please do. Appreciate the fast triage :thumbsup:

sam: Patch scheduled, will post release PR and changelog entry. 

jess: Closing loop — marking as monitored until 2026-02-20. Please reopen if new rotation shows the same behavior.
